answer: Here is one mechanism that works: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because forge only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, sonnet is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any tundra approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
